messages:
Priyash: Heads up — Lina hits 1 year at Redwood today! Anyone want to do a quick surprise + small gift? :tada:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Lina's workiversary is today. Use this thread to coordinate gifts or micro-celebrations.
Aisha: Yesss! I can help organize. Options: plant, coffee subscription, desk LED lamp, or donation to a charity of her choice. Vote below with emoji.
Marco: Can we do a 15-min virtual toast at 3pm PT? Short, sweet. I'll grab a (boxed) pastry for whoever is in the SF office.
Priyash: 15min toast works for me. I'll add a calendar event. Quick poll — react to this message: :deciduous_tree: plant, :coffee: coffee sub, :bulb: lamp, :two_hearts: donation.
Aisha: Also: budget cap $35/person? ok by people-ops? @people-ops-bot
people-ops-bot: people-ops notified — suggested per-person gift budget $30-40. Please log final decision in the sign-up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-lina-gift
Lina: Oh wow you guys, no spoilers please 😅 (but also this is cute, thank you!!)
Marco: @Lina we promise no spoilers — just come to the 3pm toast if you can join :)
Priyash: Added calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=linaworkiv
Aisha: If you're remote and want a physical gift sent, add your shipping address in the sheet. If you'd rather chip in for a donation, put amount under the "donation" column.
Priyash: Final call at 1:30pm PT — I'll order the winner (most reactions). Thanks y'all :tada::confetti_ball:
Aisha: Also making tiny desk confetti + handwritten card. If anyone wants to drop a 1-liner for the card, reply here and I'll copy them in.
Marco: "Congrats Lina — one year of powering Redwood magic!"
people-ops-bot: Sign-up sheet updated by Aisha. Last edit: 1781234785.
Priyash: Voting snapshot at 1:29pm: :deciduous_tree: 6, :coffee: 3, :bulb: 2, :two_hearts: 4 — plant wins! Ordering now.
Aisha: Ordered plant and card. ETA to SF office: 2:45pm. See you at 3pm for the quick toast :tada:
Lina: You all are the best, thank you!!! ❤️
